messages:
incident-bot: :warning: SLO ALERT: rapid increase in p95 & p99 for /v1/stream (prod, eu-central). p95 ~820ms -> 1.1s, p99 ~1.9s. Trigger rule: rolling p99 > 1.5s for 2m. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/2800004321

luis: noticed client-side drop reports for streaming frames too. no rise in 5xx. taking oncall.

anna: on it, jumping in. first glance: spike coincides with deploy window at 10:15 CET (quantized model variant rollout). deploy-bot: deploy q8-quantize v3 -> prod at 10:14:58 CET.

oncall_sre: paging infra lead @infra_lead. pagerduty-bot: page infra_lead@redwood (P1).

infra_lead: here. quick question: is the regression homogeneous or concentrated on specific node groups/regions?

anna: filtering by region shows eu-central is hit hardest. host-distribution indicates pool-euc-2 has ~3x higher p99. traffic profile: burst of long-context streams around when deploy finished.

ops-bot: note from deploy logs: `q8-quantize` changes kernel selection heuristics for attention for sequences > 1024.

luis: that could explain context-length dependency. no errors, just slower kernel path for long sequences. can we throttle long-context routing away from pool-euc-2?

oncall_sre: yes. plan: 1) put pool-euc-2 in maintenance (drain new streaming sessions), 2) rollback quantize v3 on pool-euc-2, 3) scale up a dedicated streaming pool (pool-euc-stream) temporarily and route long-context calls there.

infra_lead: initiating drain: `redwoodctl pool drain --pool=pool-euc-2 --grace=30s`

deploy-bot: rollback job submitted: `rollback q8-quantize --target=pool-euc-2 --to=v2` (job_id rb-2800004321-1). estimated finish ~75s.

anna: while that runs, I'm updating routing rules to divert queries with header `X-Request-Context-Length:>1024` to pool-euc-stream (capacity available). `redwoodctl route add --match 'header:X-Request-Context-Length>1024' --dest pool-euc-stream --priority=10`

luis: applied. immediate traffic shift ~40% of long-context traffic away. monitoring p95/p99.

infra_lead: rollback completed on pool-euc-2. preliminary p99 on that pool dropped from 1.9s -> 480ms. aggregate p99 now ~520ms.

oncall_sre: good. marking as mitigated but keeping open for 20m observation. set alert watch for reoccurrence.

luis: ran quick synthetic check with long-context prompt set (repro harness): q8-quantize v3 on staging reproduces ~2x tail vs v2 for sequences > 1500 tokens. looks like quantization selection causes slower fallback kernels under some hardware.

anna: action items for follow-up:
- block full rollout of q8-quantize v3 until p99 gating is in place (owner: infra_lead)
- add canary with long-context traffic to deploy pipeline (owner: anna)
- add metric to attach pool id to p99 alerts so mitigation is faster (owner: luis)
- provide customer comms if SLA-exposed customers are affected (owner: support)

ops-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2800004321. severity: S2. linked to deploy change q8-quantize v3.

pagerduty-bot: oncall acknowledged (P1).

infra_lead: temporary scaling note: scaled up pool-euc-stream by +3 nodes to handle diverted long-context streams. will monitor cost/latency tradeoff.

luis: customer impact estimate: ~4% of requests in past 10m breached p99 SLO (SLO=1s), ~1.2% of active sessions had degraded streaming experience. impacted customers flagged for outreach if they report issues.

anna: scheduling RCA with eng-runtime and infra tomorrow 09:00 UTC. we'll include kernel selection logs and perf traces.

oncall_sre: handoff: I'll monitor for the next 30m and then pass to next oncall. escalation criteria: p99 >1.5s for 3m or any increase in error rate.

luis: saving trace samples to `/var/trace/samples/INC-2800004321.json` (IDS obfuscated). creating quick repro PR with diag scripts.

infra_lead: long-term notes: need pre-deploy perf checks for quantized kernels across range of context lengths and hardware profiles. also add automated rollback option if p99 regression detected in first 5m of rollout.

anna: marking thread as monitoring. will update INC ticket with timeline and mitigations. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: thread will auto-archive in 45m if no additional activity."
